posts.title: A portfolio was due for a long while.
posts.body:
I know, I should have done this a long while ago but I was waiting for the moment I had something show for.

as we near the end of 2026, I have successfully created 2 beautiful projects that I really love. Thank you to the people who worked with me and helped me bring both to life.
SFA and PTS has helped me educate myself about so many things. 

It was a good year for learning. May the future hold much more for all of us.
you can check out my projects at #projects.
